dakura_origins.race.cabra.name: Goat
dakura_origins.race.cabra.description: Mountain satyrs who inherited everything from the goat: sure hooves, hard horns and thick wool. They live on snowy peaks, where no fall frightens them and no cold can reach them. Stubborn and tireless, they only rest up high, close to the sky.
dakura_origins.race.demonio.name: Demon
dakura_origins.race.demonio.description: Creatures of darkness that live by tricking and bargaining with humans. They smile at the deal and collect later. Monsters recognize them and keep away, and the Nether welcomes them like home. But the gleam of an enchantment wounds them like nothing else.
dakura_origins.race.draconica.name: Draconic
dakura_origins.race.draconica.epithet: The Beast that Will Not Share the Sky
dakura_origins.race.draconica.descriptio: Draconics are not born: they hatch, already starving and already at war. They are mountains of scale and muscle that loathe walls, ceilings and any voice but their own. They forge no alliances, beg no forgiveness and never forget an insult. Fire is their cradle, meat their only food, and every enemy slain makes them grow, taller, harder and crueler, until the sky itself seems too small for them.
dakura_origins.race.driade.name: Dryad
dakura_origins.race.driade.epithet: The Nymph Who Hears the Roots
dakura_origins.race.driade.description: Dryads are nymphs of nature, born of sap and dew. They do not see with their eyes; they feel the world through roots, wind and the warmth of the sun on their skin. They are peaceful with those who respect the forest and merciless with those who wound it. Where they walk, plants grow; where they fall, flowers bloom. But fire consumes them, the Nether burns them alive, and the forest itself punishes, without mercy, any dryad who dares to fell a tree.
dakura_origins.race.elfo.name: Elf
dakura_origins.race.elfo.epithet: One Who Measures Time in Centuries
dakura_origins.race.elfo.description: Elves live so long that human years pass them like seasons. Light, watchful and patient, they cross forests without snapping a twig and land an arrow where others can barely see the target. They are neither strong nor sturdy, and blasts and thunder wound their sensitive ears. But anyone who has hunted beside an elf knows: it senses danger long before anyone else, and is already gone when the blow lands.
dakura_origins.race.elfo_alto.name: High Elf
dakura_origins.race.elfo_alto.descriptio: Elves of the royal line, raised among gold, honor and ancient magic. Stronger than common elves, they carry a presence that protects nearby allies. With a gesture, they bind the enemy in a lasso of golden light or raise a seal that returns every blow to whoever struck it.
dakura_origins.race.elfo_noturno.name: Night Elf
dakura_origins.race.elfo_noturno.descrip: Elves who traded the sun for the shadows: silent assassins. They hunt when the moon rises, see in the dark, cross the darkness in a blink and leave decay in every cut. Even animals fear him.
dakura_origins.race.espectro.name: Specter
dakura_origins.race.espectro.description: It died, but it never left. The Specter is the soul that refused to move on: the shape at the end of the hallway, the chill that seeps through the wall, the eyes watching you in the dark when you swear you are alone. It feels no hunger, needs no light, and monsters let it pass as if it were already one of them. When death comes for it again, it simply refuses to go. But water dissolves it, the Nether claims what is its own, and everything that heals the living burns what is left of it.
dakura_origins.race.fada.name: Fairy
dakura_origins.race.fada.description: Small, bright and mischievous, fairies were born from forest dew. They fly on translucent wings, make plants grow and would rather help than fight: they perch on their friends' shoulders and scatter an enchanted dust that heals and confuses enemies.
dakura_origins.race.gargula.name: Gargoyle
dakura_origins.race.gargula.description: Statues that magic awoke. Their flesh is stone, their blood is enchantment, and their small rock wings truly fly. They neither eat nor drink: when they need strength, they stand still and become a statue again until the body mends.
dakura_origins.race.huli_jing.name: Mystic Fox
dakura_origins.race.huli_jing.descriptio: Huli Jing are fire foxes who learned to walk among people, but never to like them. Petty, suspicious and antisocial, they share nothing: not food, not shelter, not one word more than needed. They vanish when they please, trick whoever insists and burn whoever touches them. Only the world's foxes treat her like family, and they are the only company she tolerates.
dakura_origins.race.huli_jing_neve.name: Mystic Fox
dakura_origins.race.huli_jing_neve.epith: The Fox Who Won't Share the Winter
dakura_origins.race.huli_jing_neve.descr: A Huli Jing born of snow: as beautiful as she is cold, and as petty as any other. She shares no food, shelter or attention, and fades into the white when anyone comes near. Her illusions freeze those who cross her, and her trail is frost. Distrustful, solitary and too proud to ask for help, she prefers the company of foxes to that of any person.
dakura_origins.race.humano.name: Human
dakura_origins.race.humano.description: Before scales, wings and pacts with the night, there was only the Human. Born of clay and stubbornness, they carry neither blessing nor curse: only their own hands, a pickaxe and the will to shape the world block by block. Where other races depend on blood, the Human depends on choice. They are where every legend begins, the wanderer who lights the first torch in the dark and, against all odds, survives the first night.
dakura_origins.race.lilac.name: Lilac
dakura_origins.race.lilac.epithet: The Genie of Her Own Greed
dakura_origins.race.lilac.description: A lamp genie who only grants her own wishes. Surrounded by gold and addicted to gambling, she smells ore from afar and turns every blow into a bet. When luck smiles, her golden fist hits the Jackpot.
dakura_origins.race.minotauro.name: Minotaur
dakura_origins.race.minotauro.descriptio: Bull-headed giants raised in stone labyrinths. Slow and heavy, but every blow brings walls down. They hate being cornered, and when they truly bleed the fury takes over: snorting smoke, they grow even stronger.
dakura_origins.race.morto_vivo.name: Undead
dakura_origins.race.morto_vivo.epithet: The One Who Returned for Revenge
dakura_origins.race.morto_vivo.descripti: Died, but refused to accept it. The soul crawled back into its own body and now only wants to settle the score. It doesn't eat or rest, and the world's dead recognize it as one of their own. Every monster it fells strengthens the army it raises from the ground.
dakura_origins.race.orc.name: Orc
dakura_origins.race.orc.description: Warriors of the horde, green-skinned with bared tusks, raised among scars and war fires. They are neither subtle nor clever, but no one withstands their charge. When an orc roars, allies rise and enemies tremble.
dakura_origins.race.succubus.name: Succubus
dakura_origins.race.succubus.description: The sweetest face of darkness. She has a demon's strength but prefers to win by charm: a kiss that steals life, armor and memories, and a perfect disguise in anyone's skin. In daylight, though, the charm fades and her horns vanish.
dakura_origins.race.vampirica.name: Vampiric
dakura_origins.race.vampirica.epithet: The Hunger that Smiles in the Dark
dakura_origins.race.vampirica.descriptio: They do not hunt out of hunger: they hunt because they enjoy it. Vampirics are the smile that opens in the dark, the cold breath on your neck, the embrace that never lets go. Faster and stronger than any mortal, they see through the night as if it belonged to them and close their own wounds before the blood grows cold. But the sun tears them apart, and common food turns to ash in their mouths. Only blood sustains them, and when the thirst runs dry, all their glory rots along with it.
dakura_origins.race.vastaya.name: Half-Bird
dakura_origins.race.vastaya.description: A people who carry the spirit of wild beasts. Bound to the forest and wary of humankind, they are faster and stronger than any human, and among the trees they vanish completely: no footsteps, no name, no trail. Those of bird blood strike with bursts of cutting feathers.
dakura_origins.race.vastaya_cao.name: Half-Wolf
dakura_origins.race.vastaya_cao.descript: A people who carry the spirit of wild beasts. Bound to the forest and wary of humankind, they are faster and stronger than any human, and among the trees they vanish completely: no footsteps, no name, no trail. Those of wolf blood hunt in a frenzy, growling.
dakura_origins.race.vastaya_felina.name: Half-Cat
dakura_origins.race.vastaya_felina.descr: A people who carry the spirit of wild beasts. Bound to the forest and wary of humankind, they are faster and stronger than any human, and among the trees they vanish completely: no footsteps, no name, no trail. Those of feline blood run and leap like no other.
dakura_origins.message.noble_tools: A cheap tool? Only gold, diamond or netherite will do for you.
dakura_origins.message.casino_empty: Hold the item you want to bet.
dakura_origins.message.casino_lose: The house always wins... you lost it all.
dakura_origins.message.casino_even: Break even: the item comes back to you.
dakura_origins.race.boneca.name: Doll
dakura_origins.race.boneca.description: A doll of porcelain and gears, built for stages and grand performances. But something cursed latched onto the key that winds her heart: when she dances, every step becomes a cut, and the threads that once guided her now bind whoever stands in her way.
dakura_origins.race.kitsune.name: Kitsune
dakura_origins.race.kitsune.description: A fox who lived a thousand years and earned nine tails as white as snow. A messenger of the shrines, she keeps a star pearl that brings her back from death. Her ghost flames heal those she protects and burn those she hunts, and when all nine tails open, the celestial fox spirit itself descends to fight by her side.
dakura_origins.message.pacifist: You raise your hand against no creature.
dakura_origins.message.doll_armor: Your porcelain body can't bear heavy armor.
dakura_origins.message.altar_empty: Hold the item to be blessed.
dakura_origins.message.altar_none: This item can't receive any more blessings.
dakura_origins.message.altar_lost: The item left your hands: the blessing was lost.
dakura_origins.altar.title: Altar
dakura_origins.altar.hint: Choose a blessing for the item in your hand
dakura_origins.race.sereia.name: Mermaid
dakura_origins.race.sereia.description: A daughter of the deep sea, with pearl scales and a voice that calms storms. On land she walks like anyone else, but the moment she touches water her legs become a shimmering tail. Her song bewitches monsters and protects her friends, and when she is angered the ocean itself rises in a giant wave to obey her.
dakura_origins.race.fenix.name: Phoenix
dakura_origins.race.fenix.description: An eternal firebird in human form, with wings of golden flame and a burning crest. She flies like the rising sun and dives like a comet. When death comes, she becomes an egg of flames and is reborn from her own ashes, stronger. Her sacred fire burns enemies and heals friends.
dakura_origins.race.vastaya_coelho.name: Half-Rabbit
dakura_origins.race.vastaya_coelho.epith: The Hare of the Full Moon
dakura_origins.race.vastaya_coelho.descr: A half-rabbit with long ears and legs like springs. She uses no weapons or magic: she fights with fists and feet only, too fast to follow. Every consecutive blow makes her quicker, until a crescent-moon kick sends the enemy flying into the sky. They say she trained under the full moon until she could leap up to it.
dakura_origins.race.dama_cogumelo.name: Mushroom Dame
dakura_origins.race.dama_cogumelo.descri: A dryad who grew in the damp shade of the forests, where light barely reaches. Instead of flowers, she carries a huge mushroom cap and a cauldron of purple poison. She taints the ground wherever she goes, and when she is close to death, a giant mushroom bursts from the earth and lifts her out of harm's way.
dakura_origins.race.dragao_marrom.name: Brown Dragon
dakura_origins.race.dragao_marrom.descri: A smaller, nimbler dragon with earth-colored scales, standing 2.5 blocks tall from the moment it hatches. It lacks the red dragon's brute strength, but every foe it brings down raises its power: its green magma shots multiply, and its aerial charge grabs the enemy, climbs to the clouds and hurls it into the ground.
dakura_origins.message.fungal_emergency: A giant mushroom bursts up and lifts you out of danger!
dakura_origins.message.skyfall_cancel: You were hit and lost your grip.
dakura_origins.message.wing_armor: Your wing won't let you wear a chestplate.
dakura_origins.message.kitsune_grow: ✦ A new tail awakens. Your spirit matures.
dakura_origins.race.kitsune_corrompida.d: A Kitsune who tasted the strength of others and could not stop. Her nine tails darkened to night and violet, and her power now grows by devouring. She chains her prey with black comets before eating them.
dakura_origins.message.corrupt_grow: The hunger grows: new shadow tails unfold!
dakura_origins.message.devour_wait: Still sated: %s s until you can devour again.
dakura_origins.message.devour_strong: Too strong to devour. Weaken it first.
dakura_origins.message.devour_ready: The hunger is back: you can devour.
dakura_origins.message.reroll_ready: Reroll ready: hit a chest to roll the dice!
dakura_origins.command.no_maturity: Your race has no maturity system.
dakura_origins.command.no_cooldown_on: No-cooldown mode ON (run again to turn off).
dakura_origins.race.elfo_lua.name: Moon Elf
dakura_origins.race.elfo_lua.description: Graceful elves who dance under the moonlight. By day they are delicate, but when the moon rises they become pure blades: they trap enemies in an eclipse beam and bring the moon itself down on them. Even the Warden recognizes their harmony with darkness.
dakura_origins.message.needs_roof: You can only sleep with a ceiling within 6 blocks above.
dakura_origins.message.nether_weak: The Nether smothers your nature: your powers fall dormant here.
dakura_origins.message.nether_restored: Away from the Nether, your powers awaken again.
dakura_origins.message.locked: You are held and can't act!
dakura_origins.message.no_surface: No solid ground in sight to go to.
dakura_origins.race.boneca.trait.0: Body of porcelain and gears: doesn't eat, doesn't breathe and doesn't feel poison.
dakura_origins.race.boneca.trait.1: Stage grace: faster and falls from greater heights unharmed.
dakura_origins.race.boneca.trait.2: Passive — Doll Leap: at low health, she leaps away to reposition (every 30 s).
dakura_origins.race.boneca.trait.4: Fire melts porcelain: double fire damage.
dakura_origins.race.boneca.trait.5: Can't bear heavy armor (only leather, chainmail or gold).
dakura_origins.race.boneca.trait.6: Water rusts the gears: slow in water.
dakura_origins.race.boneca.trait.7: Cloth feet: never tramples farmland or ruins crops.
dakura_origins.race.boneca.ability.0.des: A fast, pointed forward slash that dashes the Doll ahead. Almost no cooldown. After 3 slashes in a row, the next ignores armor, wears down armor and shields, deals more damage the lower the target health, and applies a random effect: freeze, poison, weakness, slowness or wither.
dakura_origins.race.cabra.trait.0: Tougher than a human, with the same strength and health.
dakura_origins.race.cabra.trait.3: Hooves walk on powder snow and magma blocks unharmed.
dakura_origins.race.cabra.trait.4: Wool guards against cold and heat: immune to freezing, and fire hurts less.
dakura_origins.race.cabra.trait.5: Child of the heights: stronger above height 100.
dakura_origins.race.cabra.trait.7: Eats only plants, and each food fills less.
dakura_origins.race.cabra.trait.8: Can only sleep up high (above height 100).
dakura_origins.race.cabra.ability.0.name: Mountain Leap
dakura_origins.race.cabra.ability.0.desc: Hold the key to charge and release to jump, like a horse, but much higher. The more charge, the higher and farther.
dakura_origins.race.cabra.ability.1.name: Headbutt
dakura_origins.race.cabra.ability.1.desc: Charges with the horns and sends the first target ahead flying far away.
Slender 2.5-block body, stronger and tougher than a human.
Immune to her own poison: inside it she takes no damage or slowness, gains a golden shield and heals.
Creature of the shade: stronger at night.
Passive — Emergency Mushroom: when she drops to 4 hearts, she bursts into poison, a giant mushroom sprouts and carries her to the top, regenerating for 10 s (every 3 minutes).
The sun dries her out: weaker by day.
Fungal alchemist: potions she brews herself in a brewing stand come out doubled.
dakura_origins.race.dama_cogumelo.abilit: Hurls an iron cauldron in an arc. Where it lands it bursts and stays planted in the ground for 10 s, leaking a purple poison that spreads up to 10 blocks: continuous damage, blindness and slowness.

Automatic: when she drops to 4 hearts, a burst of purple poison pushes enemies away, a giant mushroom sprouts from the ground and the Dame is carried to the top, regenerating for 10 s. Recharges in 3 minutes.
dakura_origins.race.demonio.ability.0.de: Opens a blood pentagram in front of him that blocks blows from the front. Two chains burst from it, each binding an enemy up to 5 blocks away: for 5 seconds they burn, take constant damage and have their life drained to heal the Demon (stronger with each maturity phase).
dakura_origins.race.demonio.ability.1.de: Keeps the last creature you killed. Tap to become it (and again to change back); hold to release the stored form. Flyers can fly and water creatures breathe underwater.
dakura_origins.race.draconica.trait.0: Dragon wings: it can fly now.
dakura_origins.race.draconica.trait.1: Colossal yet agile body: starts at 2.5 blocks, grows up to 3.5 as it matures, and walks a little faster than a human.
dakura_origins.race.draconica.trait.2: Natural plating equal to a full set of iron armor, and far more health.
dakura_origins.race.draconica.trait.3: Child of the heat: immune to fire and lava, and regenerates inside the flames.
dakura_origins.race.draconica.trait.4: Superior brute strength. Health, plating, strength and ability damage rise with every stage.
dakura_origins.race.draconica.trait.7: Too big for armor: instead, it matures by slaying monsters.
dakura_origins.race.draconica.trait.8: Without about 6 free blocks overhead, it becomes slow, hungry and trembling.
dakura_origins.race.draconica.trait.9: Does not use experience: the bar shows its maturity.
dakura_origins.race.draconica.trait.10: Heavy body: much slower in water.
dakura_origins.race.draconica.trait.12: Dragon's sleep: can only sleep with a solid ceiling within 6 blocks above.
Fires a sphere of draconic fire that explodes with the force of TNT, pushes back moderately and truly sets everyone nearby and the ground around on fire.
Raises a claw and slams down with all its weight: the shockwave hurls everything within 4 blocks into the air and deals heavy damage.
Dragon wings: it flies (a bit slower than other winged races).
Agile: much faster than the red dragon, with a fixed height of 2.5 blocks.
Immune to fire and fall damage.
Maturity by kills: every defeated foe (monsters, players and other creatures) counts. It increases the number of magma shots.
Less health and less brute strength than the red dragon.
Dragon's sleep: can only sleep with a solid ceiling within 6 blocks above.
dakura_origins.race.dragao_marrom.abilit: The same fireball as the Draconic, in green and blue flames: it explodes, pushes moderately and truly sets nearby enemies and the ground on fire.

Grabs the enemy in front and spreads its wings for 3 s (taking damage in that time releases the target). Then it flies up with it and dives into the ground: green explosion, crater and green fire on the spot, with massive damage.
dakura_origins.race.driade.trait.0: A slender 2.5-block body, stronger and tougher than a human.
dakura_origins.race.driade.trait.1: Photosynthesis: under the sun it regenerates faster and its hunger fills on its own.
dakura_origins.race.driade.trait.2: Nearby crops grow faster, and much faster while she stands still near them (as long as they have the right light, water and soil).
dakura_origins.race.driade.trait.4: Immune to poison, wither and the thorns of bushes.
dakura_origins.race.driade.trait.5: Firm roots: barely gets knocked back.
dakura_origins.race.driade.trait.7: At night it grows a little weaker.
dakura_origins.race.driade.trait.8: Breaking a tree is betrayal: the forest kills it on the spot.
dakura_origins.race.driade.trait.10: Fire deals double damage, and in the Nether it catches fire.
dakura_origins.race.driade.trait.11: When it dies, flowers sprout across the ground around it.
dakura_origins.race.driade.trait.12: In the Nether loses every racial advantage and ability (all return on leaving, no progress lost).
dakura_origins.race.driade.ability.0.des: Releases a wave of natural energy in a 20-block radius: saplings become trees, crops ripen and plants grow instantly, following the game rules (proper space and soil). 5-minute cooldown.
dakura_origins.race.driade.ability.1.des: Daytime only: raises one arm, gathers a sphere of sunlight and fires a huge beam that tunnels through the blocks ahead.
dakura_origins.race.elfo.trait.0: Light steps: faster, and falls from greater heights unharmed.
dakura_origins.race.elfo.trait.1: Born archer: arrows and other projectiles deal 50% more damage.
dakura_origins.race.elfo.trait.2: Long-lived: hunger drops at half the pace.
dakura_origins.race.elfo.trait.5: Sensitive ears: explosions deal double damage.
dakura_origins.race.elfo.trait.6: Refined palate: refuses rotten flesh, spider eyes and poisonous potatoes.
dakura_origins.race.elfo.trait.8: Natural harmony: animals don't run from him.
dakura_origins.race.elfo.ability.0.name: Nimble Retreat
dakura_origins.race.elfo.ability.0.descr: Leaps nimbly backward and, mid-leap, fires an orb of arcane energy forward that bursts in blue light on impact (no fire).
dakura_origins.race.elfo.ability.1.name: Hunter's Gaze
dakura_origins.race.elfo.ability.1.descr: For 10 seconds, sees the outline of every creature within 40 blocks, even through walls.
dakura_origins.race.elfo_alto.trait.0: Royal archer: arrows and other projectiles deal 60% more damage.
dakura_origins.race.elfo_alto.trait.4: Light steps: falls from greater heights unharmed.
dakura_origins.race.elfo_alto.trait.5: Passive — Golden Aegis: every 60 s it gains a golden outline that cancels the next attack. Melee hit: the attacker and those nearby are hurled away. Projectile or thrown ability: it teleports away before the impact (if it lands in the air, it falls slowly).
dakura_origins.race.elfo_alto.trait.6: Passive — Royal Presence: nearby players get regeneration and luck.
dakura_origins.race.elfo_alto.trait.7: Noble and frail: 9 hearts, and no extra melee strength.
dakura_origins.race.elfo_alto.trait.8: Sensitive ears: explosions deal double damage.
dakura_origins.race.elfo_alto.trait.9: Royal palate: refuses rotten flesh, spider eyes and poisonous potatoes.
dakura_origins.race.elfo_alto.trait.10: Luxury is costly: hunger drops faster.
dakura_origins.race.elfo_alto.trait.11: Natural harmony: animals don't run from her.
A golden beam grabs the target in your sights and keeps it suspended in front of you for up to 10 s, following your gaze (the camera stays free). The scroll wheel pulls it closer or pushes it away. Attack to hurl it hard where you aim: it takes damage when it hits the ground, walls or other creatures. Use again to release.
Opens a large golden rune circle in front of you that spins endlessly. For a few seconds every enemy blow is absorbed and returned to them as if by a mirror.
dakura_origins.race.elfo_noturno.trait.1: At night he grows much stronger and faster.
dakura_origins.race.elfo_noturno.trait.2: Silent assassin: soundless steps, day and night.
dakura_origins.race.elfo_noturno.trait.4: Shadow blade: his blows inflict decay (Wither).
dakura_origins.race.elfo_noturno.trait.9: Known killer: animals flee from him.
dakura_origins.race.elfo_noturno.ability: Three iron swords wrapped in a purple and pink aura float above his head, tips forward. On his next hit (or using it again, at his aim) they launch homing at the target, dealing high damage and decay (Wither).
Dissolves into shadow and reappears on any solid ground he can see, up to 32 blocks away, invisible for a moment. Never passes through walls.
dakura_origins.race.espectro.trait.0: Already dead: it feels no hunger and never needs to eat.
dakura_origins.race.espectro.trait.2: A little stronger than a human, but frailer: only 8 hearts.
dakura_origins.race.espectro.trait.3: Monsters don't attack it unless it strikes first.
dakura_origins.race.espectro.trait.4: Second Chance (passive): when it dies, it stays standing with 1 heart and light regeneration. 5-minute cooldown.
dakura_origins.race.espectro.trait.5: Light as mist: takes no fall damage.
dakura_origins.race.espectro.trait.6: Water dissolves it: rain and oceans deal heavy damage.
dakura_origins.race.espectro.trait.7: The Nether is hell: there he dissolves as in rain and loses every advantage and ability (all return on leaving, no progress lost).
dakura_origins.race.espectro.trait.8: Healing potions and positive effects hurt it; negative effects make it stronger.
dakura_origins.race.espectro.ability.0.d: Turns invisible and passes through walls, like a spectator, with no time limit. Press again to become visible.
dakura_origins.race.fada.trait.0: Truly flies with moth wings (double jump to take off).
dakura_origins.race.fada.trait.1: Too small to be noticed: monsters don't see or attack her, until she attacks one of them (then the truce ends for 30 seconds).
dakura_origins.race.fada.trait.2: Eats like a bird: every food fills and saturates twice as much, and hunger drains at half speed.
dakura_origins.race.fada.trait.3: Slowly regenerates and makes nearby plants grow.
dakura_origins.race.fada.trait.4: Lily pad: when she lands on water, a lily pad appears under her feet and keeps her afloat (sneak to dive).
dakura_origins.race.fada.trait.5: Perched on a friend's shoulder, both regenerate together.
dakura_origins.race.fada.trait.6: Very fragile: only 6 hearts, and weak blows.
dakura_origins.race.fada.trait.9: Fairy blessing: no fall damage, sees in the dark, lucky, faster and reaches blocks farther away.
dakura_origins.race.fada.ability.0.name: Shoulder Perch
dakura_origins.race.fada.ability.0.descr: Perches on the nearest player's shoulder: while she's there, both regenerate and they earn double experience. Use again (or sneak) to leave.
dakura_origins.race.fada.ability.1.name: Flower Sanctuary
dakura_origins.race.fada.ability.1.descr: Opens a large magic circle on the ground for 15 seconds. No monster can get in, and a field of enchanted flowers blooms inside, constantly healing the players and allies within the circle.
dakura_origins.race.fenix.trait.0: Fire wings with their own light: flies, and the glow grows during attacks.
dakura_origins.race.fenix.trait.1: Body of flame: immune to fire and lava, and her blows set enemies ablaze.
dakura_origins.race.fenix.trait.3: Passive — Rebirth: when she dies, she becomes an egg of flames and is reborn at full health, bursting into fire (every 3 minutes).
dakura_origins.race.fenix.trait.4: Water and rain douse her flame: she takes damage while wet.
dakura_origins.race.fenix.trait.5: Cold weakens her: double freezing damage.
dakura_origins.race.fenix.trait.7: Forge touch: ores she breaks drop already smelted.
dakura_origins.race.fenix.trait.8: Covered nest: can only sleep with a solid ceiling within 6 blocks above.
dakura_origins.race.fenix.ability.0.name: Solar Dive
dakura_origins.race.fenix.ability.0.desc: Shoots upward in a burst of flame, pauses high in the air as a sun ignites behind her, and dives like a comet where she aims. The impact opens a ring of sunlight on the ground: damage, fire and knockback (doesn't break blocks). The ground around the impact catches fire.
dakura_origins.race.fenix.ability.1.name: Wings of Dawn
dakura_origins.race.fenix.ability.1.desc: Spreads giant wings of fire and releases a ring of blazing feathers. The sacred fire knows friends: allies heal, are cleansed and become immune to fire, while enemies burn. A small sun keeps pulsing for 4 seconds. The ground around her bursts into flames.
dakura_origins.race.gargula.trait.0: Same health as a human, but far tougher and stronger.
dakura_origins.race.gargula.trait.1: Truly flies with stone wings (double jump to take off).
dakura_origins.race.gargula.trait.2: Standing still on the ground for 5 seconds, turns into a statue and recovers health and hunger.
dakura_origins.race.gargula.trait.3: Immune to knockback and fire, and never drowns.
dakura_origins.race.gargula.trait.4: Stone Skin (passive): hits of more than 5 hearts lose 3 hearts of damage.
dakura_origins.race.gargula.trait.6: Can't eat anything (in exchange, hunger drops slowly).
dakura_origins.race.gargula.trait.7: Sinks in water and can't swim.
dakura_origins.race.gargula.trait.8: Under the sun the stone grows heavy: slower by day.
dakura_origins.race.gargula.trait.9: Stone eyes: sees in the dark.
dakura_origins.race.gargula.ability.0.de: Leaps sky-high, turns to stone and plummets: the impact hurts everything around and hurls enemies far away. No fall damage.
dakura_origins.race.huli_jing.trait.0: Stronger than a human, but with only 8 hearts.
dakura_origins.race.huli_jing.trait.2: Immune to fire; every hit, with any weapon, sets the enemy ablaze.
dakura_origins.race.huli_jing.trait.3: Silent footsteps; after standing still for 3 seconds she turns invisible and no monster notices her.
dakura_origins.race.huli_jing.trait.4: Foxes don't flee from her and even follow her for a while.
dakura_origins.race.huli_jing.trait.6: No effect works on her, good or bad (not even golden apples).
dakura_origins.race.huli_jing.trait.8: Can't swim: water doesn't hurt her, but she sinks.
Turns into a swift fox that makes huge leaps. In this form enemies ignore her and she can't attack: the attack button unleashes a fire explosion that breaks blocks and restores her human form.
Creates three fox illusions that fight by your side, with no time limit (new illusions replace the old ones).
dakura_origins.race.huli_jing_neve.trait: Stronger than a human, but with only 8 hearts.
Immune to frost and walks on powder snow; every hit, with any weapon, slows the enemy.
Silent footsteps; after standing still for 3 seconds she turns invisible and no monster notices her.
Foxes don't flee from her and even follow her for a while.
No effect works on her, good or bad (not even golden apples).
Can't swim: water doesn't hurt her, but she sinks.
dakura_origins.race.huli_jing_neve.abili: Turns into a swift fox that makes huge leaps. In this form enemies ignore her and she can't attack: the attack button unleashes a ice explosion that breaks blocks and restores her human form.
Creates three fox illusions that fight by your side, with no time limit (new illusions replace the old ones).
dakura_origins.race.humano.trait.0: Adaptable: learns fast and gains 20% more experience.
dakura_origins.race.humano.trait.1: No supernatural gift: magic and poison hurt a little more.
dakura_origins.race.humano.trait.2: The classic Minecraft experience, with no shortcuts and no strings attached.
dakura_origins.race.kitsune.trait.0: Growing tails: starts with 3 tails and gains 3 more at each maturity stage, up to 9. Health, strength, damage and the number of orbs grow with them.
dakura_origins.race.kitsune.trait.1: Fox eyes: night vision, and luck always follows her.
dakura_origins.race.kitsune.trait.3: Passive — Star Pearl: when she dies, she gets back up with 1 heart (every 10 minutes).
dakura_origins.race.kitsune.trait.4: Spirit maturity: does not use the experience bar; grows by defeating monsters. The bar changes color each stage and takes a long time to fill.
dakura_origins.race.kitsune.trait.7: Creature of the night: a little weaker by day.
dakura_origins.race.kitsune.trait.8: Foxfire and spirit frost: her blows burn and freeze, and she is immune to frost (fire hurts her normally).
dakura_origins.race.kitsune.trait.9: Agile: runs faster and jumps higher.
dakura_origins.race.kitsune.trait.10: Light paws: walks on powder snow without sinking.
dakura_origins.race.kitsune.ability.0.de: Throws a sphere of blue mana where you aim. If it hits a creature, it explodes hard and flies back to the Kitsune, exploding again when it arrives. If it hits nothing, it just comes back, with no explosions.
dakura_origins.race.kitsune.ability.1.de: Mana orbs with comet trails start orbiting around her (3, 6 or 9, depending on maturity). On her next hit, or when used again while aiming at a creature, they all fire as homing missiles, one after another, and explode on the target.
dakura_origins.race.kitsune_corrompida.t: Shadow tails: starts with 3 tails and gains 3 more each stage, up to 9. Health, strength and damage grow more than the common Kitsune.
Fox eyes: night vision, and luck always follows her.
Passive — Star Pearl: on death, gets back up with 1 heart (every 10 minutes).

Passive — Devour and Evolve: while sneaking, hit a weakened creature to devour it (every 5 min). Maturity only grows this way: animals give almost nothing, monsters little, bosses a lot. Each player only counts once.
Night creature: a bit weaker by day.
Foxfire and spirit frost: her blows burn and freeze, and she is immune to frost (fire hurts her normally).
Light paws: walks on powder snow without sinking.
dakura_origins.race.kitsune_corrompida.a: Throws a blue mana orb. If it hits a creature it explodes and returns, exploding again on arrival. If it misses, it just returns.

Black chains leap from her and instantly bind the nearest enemies within 10 blocks: 3, 6 or 9 depending on maturity. Bound, they take damage and freeze in place; then they stay chained, pulled back if they go beyond 10 blocks and taking damage over time until the chains break.
dakura_origins.race.lilac.trait.0: Much stronger and tougher than a human.
dakura_origins.race.lilac.trait.1: Natural fortune: ores she breaks drop as if her tool had Fortune II, even unenchanted (only for her).
dakura_origins.race.lilac.trait.3: Passive — Midas Touch: defeated monsters sometimes drop gold nuggets.
dakura_origins.race.lilac.trait.4: Only uses gold, diamond or netherite tools and weapons.
dakura_origins.race.lilac.trait.5: Without gold in her inventory, she loses strength and speed.
dakura_origins.race.lilac.ability.0.name: Golden Fist
dakura_origins.race.lilac.ability.0.desc: A heavy gold-covered punch. With a small chance it hits the JACKPOT: triple damage, a golden blast and fireworks.
dakura_origins.race.lilac.ability.1.name: Casino
dakura_origins.race.lilac.ability.1.desc: Bets the item in your hand on a wheel of fortune: you may lose it all, break even or multiply it by 2, 3 or even 5. The rarer the item, the harder it is to win.
dakura_origins.race.minotauro.trait.0: 2.5 blocks tall, great strength and great toughness.
dakura_origins.race.minotauro.trait.1: Breaks blocks much faster, and hunger drops slowly.
dakura_origins.race.minotauro.trait.2: Firm stance: nearly impossible to push.
dakura_origins.race.minotauro.trait.4: Gets slow and restless in cramped places.
dakura_origins.race.minotauro.trait.5: Vegetarian, and each food fills less.
dakura_origins.race.minotauro.trait.6: Can't wear a helmet because of the horns.
Passive: at 4 hearts or less it flies into a rage, with strong regeneration and much more strength, snorting white smoke. Ends once it recovers.
Rips a large stone block from the ground and hurls it where you aim: it explodes on impact and scatters shards.
dakura_origins.race.morto_vivo.trait.1: Zombies, skeletons and other undead ignore it, unless it attacks.
dakura_origins.race.morto_vivo.trait.3: Killing monsters strengthens its zombies, in 4 levels (instead of experience).
dakura_origins.race.morto_vivo.trait.4: Lifeless body: immune to poison and hunger.
dakura_origins.race.morto_vivo.trait.7: Healing potions and powers harm it.
dakura_origins.race.morto_vivo.trait.9: In the Nether loses every racial advantage and ability (all return on leaving, no progress lost).
dakura_origins.race.morto_vivo.ability.0: Raises 5 chainmail zombies that attack whoever you attack (or whoever attacks you) for 30 seconds. At higher levels they get swords and better armor, up to enchanted iron.
dakura_origins.race.orc.trait.1: Thick hide: natural armor and barely gets pushed.
dakura_origins.race.orc.trait.2: Iron stomach: immune to poison and hunger.
dakura_origins.race.orc.trait.3: A bit bigger than a human.
dakura_origins.race.orc.trait.7: Butcher: animals he slays drop double meat and leather.
dakura_origins.race.orc.ability.0.name: War Cry
dakura_origins.race.orc.ability.0.descri: A roar that shakes the ground: nearby allies gain strength and resistance; monsters are pushed back, weakened and slowed.
dakura_origins.race.orc.ability.1.name: Brutal Charge
dakura_origins.race.orc.ability.1.descri: Charges in a straight line, trampling and hurling everything in the way, and ends with a slam into the ground.
dakura_origins.race.sereia.trait.0: Breathes underwater and swims like a dolphin: in water she gains Dolphin's Grace and Conduit Power.
dakura_origins.race.sereia.trait.2: Sea glow: a blue aura at night.
dakura_origins.race.sereia.trait.3: Passive — Mermaid Tail: in water her legs become a scaled tail.
dakura_origins.race.sereia.trait.4: Dry scales: out of water and rain for 90 s, she becomes slow and weak until she gets wet.
dakura_origins.race.sereia.trait.6: Fire dries her scales: 50% more fire damage.
dakura_origins.race.sereia.trait.7: Sea queen: in water she gains much more strength, armor, max health and attack speed, and keeps regenerating health.
dakura_origins.race.sereia.trait.8: Always a tail: on land she cannot walk, only crawl slowly.
dakura_origins.race.sereia.trait.9: Deep-sea miner: breaks blocks at normal speed underwater.
dakura_origins.race.sereia.ability.0.des: Sings a hypnotic melody in waves of notes and bubbles. Nearby monsters forget their target and are slowly drawn in, enchanted. Allies heal and gain water breathing.
dakura_origins.race.sereia.ability.1.des: Raises a giant curling wave that rolls forward, sweeping and drowning enemies and putting out fire. The Mermaid surfs on its crest.
dakura_origins.race.succubus.trait.0: Same strength, speed and resistances as a Demon.
dakura_origins.race.succubus.trait.1: Her villager discount comes from charm: charmed villagers give rock-bottom prices.
dakura_origins.race.succubus.trait.2: Monsters won't attack it unless it attacks first.
dakura_origins.race.succubus.trait.3: The closer to death, the more it regenerates.
dakura_origins.race.succubus.trait.6: By day she loses all her strength and her horns.
dakura_origins.race.succubus.trait.7: Enchanted weapons deal much more damage to it, and it can't use or wear anything enchanted.
dakura_origins.race.succubus.trait.8: Poison, hunger and decay hurt it more.
dakura_origins.race.succubus.ability.0.d: Holds the target in a kiss that drains everything: life (which you absorb), armor and experience. In the end, it is left charmed by you.
dakura_origins.race.succubus.ability.1.d: Copies the appearance of a player in your sights and physically steals their attributes (health, worn armor, strength, size...), but not their abilities. Lasts 1 minute; use again to undo.
dakura_origins.race.vampirica.trait.2: Accelerated regeneration of their own wounds.
dakura_origins.race.vampirica.trait.3: Blood never rots: immune to poison.
dakura_origins.race.vampirica.trait.4: Sunlight burns the flesh. Rain, water and shade protect.
dakura_origins.race.vampirica.trait.5: Feeds only on blood: common food is rejected.
dakura_origins.race.vampirica.trait.6: With an empty hunger bar, loses every gift of the race.
dakura_origins.race.vampirica.trait.7: Fire consumes her faster: 50% more damage.
Seizes the prey in front of you in a predatory embrace and drinks its life for 1.5 s, healing you and sating your hunger. Monster blood is rotten: it poisons.
Dissolves into smoke and becomes a bat: free flight with no time limit. Press again to turn back.
dakura_origins.race.vastaya.trait.0: Faster and stronger than a human; falls barely hurt.
dakura_origins.race.vastaya.trait.2: In forests: silent steps, no name tag, off the radar, and monsters won't attack unless it attacks first.
dakura_origins.race.vastaya.trait.4: A single natural wing on its back: glides exactly like an elytra (jump midair to open; opens by itself when falling from high; sneak to close).
dakura_origins.race.vastaya.trait.5: The wing doesn't let it wear a chestplate.
dakura_origins.race.vastaya.trait.6: Far from nature: weaker in the Nether.
dakura_origins.race.vastaya.ability.0.de: For 10 seconds, senses monsters and players near and far (up to 48 blocks), even through walls.
dakura_origins.race.vastaya.ability.1.de: Fires a volley of feather-daggers, the race's own arrows: they stick into the target's body, cause weakness and stack damage on the same target.
dakura_origins.race.vastaya_cao.trait.0: Faster and stronger than a human; falls barely hurt.
dakura_origins.race.vastaya_cao.trait.2: In forests: silent steps, no name above the head, hidden from radars, and monsters won't attack unless attacked first.
dakura_origins.race.vastaya_cao.trait.5: Far from nature: weaker in the Nether.
dakura_origins.race.vastaya_cao.trait.6: Pack soul: tames wolves with a single bone, and his dogs gain constant healing and extra strength near him.
For 10 seconds, senses monsters and players near and far (up to 48 blocks), even through walls.
Enters hunting mode for 10 seconds: growls, gets stronger and faster.
dakura_origins.race.vastaya_coelho.trait: Spring legs: very fast, jumps very high and falls from great heights unharmed.
Fighting master: +4 damage and much faster attacks.
Passive — Hare's Frenzy: each consecutive blow stacks haste and speed; on the sixth, a Lunar Kick launches the enemy.
Bountiful harvest: mature crops she harvests sometimes yield double.
dakura_origins.race.vastaya_coelho.abili: Leaps at the target in her sights and unleashes 8 midair kicks, each with a starburst, finishing with a crescent kick that sends the target flying.

Dashes at the target in your sights and pins it with the first punch: it can't move, attack or flee. A barrage of ten lightning-fast punches follows, each one bursting with light where it lands, and a devastating final punch sends it flying.
dakura_origins.race.vastaya_felina.trait: Faster and stronger than a human; falls barely hurt.
In forests: silent steps, no name above the head, hidden from radars, and monsters won't attack unless attacked first.
Far from nature: weaker in the Nether.
Queen of felines: cats don't flee from her and creepers keep their distance.
dakura_origins.race.vastaya_felina.abili: For 10 seconds, senses monsters and players near and far (up to 48 blocks), even through walls.
For 8 seconds runs very fast, makes huge leaps and takes no fall damage.
dakura_origins.race.elfo_lua.trait.0: Lunar grace: at night grows much stronger, faster and tougher.
dakura_origins.race.elfo_lua.trait.2: Natural harmony: animals don't run from him.
dakura_origins.race.elfo_lua.trait.3: Child of the deep night: the Warden neither hunts nor hurts him.
dakura_origins.race.elfo_lua.trait.4: Moonlit blade: his blows inflict decay (Wither).
dakura_origins.race.elfo_lua.trait.5: Passive — Eclipse Mark: at night, every 3 hits on the same target a lunar flash bursts on it, dealing extra damage and blindness.
dakura_origins.race.elfo_lua.trait.6: Moonlit luck: at night he is much luckier (better fishing and loot in chests he opens).
dakura_origins.race.elfo_lua.trait.7: By day he loses some strength.
dakura_origins.race.elfo_lua.ability.0.d: Picks an enemy about 7 blocks away, stretches out both hands and channels a continuous beam of blue, pink, purple and black light. Lightning strikes the target, who is fully held for 5 seconds, taking constant damage, blindness and decay. Stronger at night.
dakura_origins.race.elfo_lua.ability.1.d: Raises his arms and summons a huge white moon: everyone nearby is blinded and heavily slowed, and he cannot attack while summoning. Then the moon falls slowly, homing in on the target, opening a crater and dealing massive damage.
dakura_origins.race.demonio.trait.0: More strength and speed than a human; even stronger in the Nether.
dakura_origins.race.demonio.trait.1: Infernal silver tongue: villagers give a discount without being hurt.
dakura_origins.race.demonio.trait.2: Monsters won't attack it unless it attacks first.
dakura_origins.race.demonio.trait.3: The closer to death, the more it regenerates.
dakura_origins.race.demonio.trait.6: Soul harvest: those he kills leave red souls (more souls the stronger the victim). Absorbing them, he matures through 5 phases, each stronger. Normal experience stays separate.
dakura_origins.race.demonio.trait.7: Final form: a permanent blood aura and Infernal Thorns, which return 30% of the damage taken to the attacker.
dakura_origins.race.demonio.trait.8: Enchanted weapons deal much more damage to it, and it can't use or wear anything enchanted. Curses (Binding and Vanishing) do not affect him.
dakura_origins.race.demonio.trait.9: Poison, hunger and decay hurt it more.
dakura_origins.race.demonio.trait.12: Holy repulsion: carrying any enchanted item in the inventory hurts.
